summary: Test-writing phase for issue #39: committed the solver parity corpus (verbatim from viamin/color_matching#111), a 12-scenario exact-replay parity suite, a migration-invariant PaletteAPIClient wire-contract suite, offline cache flow tests, and red structural tests for the generated OpenAPI client, plus docs/ LID documentation. No Swift toolchain exists in this Linux container (ColorComposerCore targets macOS with Core Graphics), so swift test could not be executed here; parity semantics were validated out-of-band by exact simulation over all 12 corpus scenarios (Python). Implementation (swift-openapi-generator wiring, client migration, README edit) lands in the follow-up implementation run.

acceptance_criteria.description: swift-openapi-generator + swift-openapi-runtime added to ColorComposerCore; typed client generated from the OpenAPI document; PaletteAPIClient migrated or wraps it
acceptance_criteria.reason: Implementation is out of scope for this test-writing run; committed tests run red by design until it lands

references.detail: Asserts Package.swift wires swift-openapi-generator/runtime, a committed OpenAPI document describes GET /api/v1/printer_profiles and GET /api/v1/colors, and generated sources exist under Sources/ColorComposerCore/OpenAPI. Fails at this head (expected red phase); not executable in this container (no Swift toolchain).
